activities.title: Rolls or not
activities.intro: Some things roll away. Some things stay still. Sort them into two piles: rolls, and does not roll.
activities.offScreen: Go find something round that rolls and something flat that does not, and show a grown-up.

rounds.prompt: Balls and coins roll. Blocks and cups do not roll. Put the things that roll in one pile and the things that do not roll in another pile.
Put the things that roll in one pile and the things that do not roll in another pile.
Put the things that roll in one pile and the things that do not roll in another pile.
Put the things that roll in one pile and the things that do not roll in another pile.

activities.title: Sinks or floats
activities.intro: Some things sink to the bottom of the water. Some things float on top. Sort them into two piles: sinks, and floats.
activities.offScreen: Go find something that would sink in water and something that would float, and show a grown-up.

rounds.prompt: Rocks and coins sink. Leaves and cups float. Put the things that sink in one pile and the things that float in another pile.
Put the things that sink in one pile and the things that float in another pile.
Put the things that sink in one pile and the things that float in another pile.
Put the things that sink in one pile and the things that float in another pile.

activities.title: Which ramp is steeper
activities.intro: One ramp is steeper than the other. Steep means it goes up fast in a short space. Tap the steep ramp.
activities.offScreen: Go find a ramp or a slope near you, like a driveway or a slide, and show a grown-up how steep it is.

rounds.prompt: One ramp is short and goes up fast. It is steep. The other ramp is long and goes up slowly. It is gentle. Tap the steep ramp.
One ramp is flat and takes a long time to climb. It is gentle. The other ramp shoots up in a short space. It is steep. Tap the ramp that is steeper.
This ramp is made from one book, so it is gentle. This ramp is made from a stack of books, so it is steep. Tap the steep ramp.

parentCard.title: Ramp and test
steps: Lean a book against a box or a step to make a ramp.
Pick three things from around the house, like a ball, a block and a coin.
Let them roll each thing down the ramp. After each one, ask them why do you think that happened.
Make the ramp steeper by leaning the book higher and try again.
notice: Do they guess before they try, or only after?
Do they notice that the same thing rolls faster on the steeper ramp?
